output.summary: The function fn_06 processes input data using a custom algorithm involving permutation and XOR operations, and returns the length of the processed data or an error code if the output capacity is insufficient.

claims.text: Returns 0xFFFFFFFFFFFFFFFF when out_cap < len.
Returns len when out_cap >= len.
Uses a loop to initialize an array k from the arg parameter.
Uses a loop to initialize an array s with values from 0 to 0xff.
Uses a loop to perform a permutation on the array s using values from k and s.
Uses a loop to process each byte of the input data and write to the output buffer.
Writes transformed data to out[0..len-1].
Implements a custom permutation-based transformation using XOR and array permutation.
Uses the constant 0xff in bitwise operations.
